pages.title: Food Families
pages.text: Within each food group, foods are organized into $(bold)families$(). For example, all apple-type foods share the Apple family. Eating within the same family triggers diminishing returns faster than switching to a different family in the same group.

pages.title: Why It Matters
pages.text:
You can check a food's family in its tooltip. Ideally you want to rotate across $(bold)multiple families$() within each group, not just multiple foods.

Eating an apple, then a golden apple, then an enchanted golden apple is still all Apple family — variety means switching to melons or berries instead.
